title: A filing's inputs and objective
description: The inputs and objective an order filed on an automatic deposit carries, as the operator states them when the filing holds the deposit against its order (T-020-51): the body of a statement kept in the evidence store behind the salted commitment the arrival holding the deposit names, so a Core that reopens reads the filing back and the log holds no account (REQ-AUD-6). It names no transaction and is appended about nothing.

inputs.description: Each input, by name; empty where the filing carries none.

objective.description: What the router optimises the order's route for.
